piece.headline: ANUJ CLOSES IN, SUKRUT'S LEAD SHRINKS
piece.standfirst: Sukrut stays top after a Wildcard week, but Anuj's Triple Captain has cut the gap to 9 points.
piece.big_picture: Sukrut is still first, but his lead over Anuj has shrunk. Anuj put the Triple Captain on Haaland and jumped from 5th to 2nd. Sukrut played his Wildcard and scored below the league average. Rushikesh took the week with 76.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Sahil Phadnis left 23 points on the bench, the worst of the week. He did captain Isak for 16, a clever rebel pick. The wrong 11 undid the good work.
piece.one_to_watch: Sudev and Aditya Dharap are split by a single point at the Tin Pot line. Whoever picks the better captain next week could leave the other staring up at them.

winners.name: Rushikesh
winners.verdict: Captained Haaland, played the Triple Captain and his Ødegaard and Groß swap paid off. Skill, nerve and a bit of luck. The week's best score by miles.

winners.name: Anuj
winners.verdict: Triple Captain on Haaland, and it landed. That's nerve rewarded, and it lifted him to 2nd. Sukrut will be checking his mirrors.

losers.name: Atharva Singh
losers.verdict: Gibbs-White as captain, and nobody else joined him. 3 transfers in, and 3 places lost. A brave call that left him alone.

losers.name: Sudev
losers.verdict: Backed B.Fernandes alone and it didn't pay. A rough week, with 14 points sitting on the bench. Better days are ahead.

losers.name: Parth
losers.verdict: Palmer was Parth's lone captain pick and he delivered 4. A full 11 more sat on the bench. Brutal.

ratings.l: Everything came off. The rest of the league can only look on.
